status_reason: Resources fixed: design ERAM 72 (preview removed), CWC 30 fits (102<=280), LUT 16,753/reg 16,059. The bridge output skid register removed the P1 store read-data path: clk_a1->clk_a1 is now SWNS +0.116, 0/14,968 violations. The remaining failure is the reset distribution into the frozen A+ core: path group sys_clk50m->clk_a1, SWNS -0.193 / STNS -63.883 / 331 endpoints, start a1_rst_sync_reg[2], end u_a1/u_a1/u_a1/smem.addrb (inside a1_deflate_core/a1_frame_top). In the small top rst_n was a primary port (untimed); the board synchronizer makes the core reset->memory-address mux a timed path. The clk_a1 data path is only +0.116 at synth (small-top +0.275; board required 5.266 vs 5.333), so even excluding the reset path a route-only pass is unlikely to reach WNS>0/+0.2. Fix requires a reset false path (real async, forbidden by r2 stop conditions) or a core/frame reset/pipeline change (forbidden). Stopped for the board-level boundary decision; no route/bitgen/CWC.
